details:
I'm looking at https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/ios-bug-doesnt-allow-to-join-group-publics/voters as an example, and I'm seeing a lot of users without profile icons in that topic. The profile icon for these users is simply the first character of their display name.

When I look at a few VRChat profiles of these users, they have custom profile icons set in VRChat but the icons are missing on VRChat Feedback.

When an user logs in to VRChat Feedback directly at https://feedback.vrchat.com/ outside of in-client bug reporting, it seems an user gets a profile icon on VRChat Feedback from the login authorization automatically. The icon can't be changed manually from https://feedback.vrchat.com/settings, so this seems like a bug where setting the icon is skipped if the user submits an in-client bug report only and never logs into VRChat Feedback directly.

Expected result: See / update an user's VRChat profile icon when available, when creating an in-client bug report.

Actual result: The icon is not set on VRChat Feedback when an in-client bug report is submitted, and a fallback of the first alphabet of their display name is shown.
title: In-client bug reporting doesn't set a profile icon on VRChat Feedback
